PROFESSOR ZHOU / DUAL-MARKET MODEL

How do two markets shape local cooperation?

Political market

In Zhou’s model, officials compete on their jurisdictions’ relative performance. In Taopu, Putuo sought more productive use of industrial land.

Economic market

GLP competes for tenants. A modern park with access to Shanghai customers can make staying commercially attractive.

Where the incentives meet

Putuo enabled more floor space. Tenant demand tests its commercial value.

Zhou (2018), model background · Putuo planning authority

COURSE 2.6 / ADMINISTRATIVE SUBCONTRACT

What did each level of government do?

Shanghai municipality

Listed the project as a major municipal project in 2024 and 2025.

Putuo district

Coordinated planning and approvals. Applied the existing-land policy and waived the incremental land premium.

Taopu town

Worked with district planners and GLP to coordinate the redevelopment locally.

Both of Putuo’s top district leadership posts changed hands between signing and opening. The project stayed on Shanghai’s major-project list and Phase I opened in September 2025. What helped sustain implementation across the leadership transition?

Putuo planning authority · City, district and town roles · Party secretary appointment · District mayor election

Local government

Market feedback
